desc: Prove that sorting descending makes the expression monotone with respect to increasing any index.
Implement heap state traversal with valid one-coordinate successor generation.
Prevent duplicate index triples using a hash set.
Confirm Python arbitrary-precision integers safely handle all products and sums.
Analyze complexity as `O(N log N + K log K)` time and `O(K)` additional memory.
Run and verify the implementation on all provided samples.
